_comment_checks: Set any check to false to skip that detection module entirely.
_comment_thresholds: Numeric floors — threats below these levels are not raised.

npmAudit._comment: Minimum combined high+critical vuln count before flagging (default: 1).

outdatedDeps._comment: Minimum major-version gap before a package is flagged (default: 1).

_comment_suppressions: Each rule suppresses threats where ALL specified fields match.
Fields: check, category, messageContains, reason, until (ISO date — auto-expires).
At least one of check / category / messageContains must be set.

suppressions._comment: Example: suppress outdated-dep noise for an internal fork.
suppressions.reason: Internal fork — not updated on npm

suppressions._comment: Example: suppress all NPM_DOCTOR findings in offline CI.
suppressions.reason: npm doctor is unreliable in air-gapped CI environments
